runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared and asynchronous jobs disabled by the delegation probe overlay.
runtime.permissionProfile: Only read and task tools enabled; fixture required no writes

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-delegation Skill.
One native task call started exactly one bundled read-only scout named ChildMarkerReader.
Synchronous task completion returned one completed task-result payload to the root.
The scout read assets/child.txt and returned CHILD_MARKER=delegation-ok with its resource path.
The root read assets/root.txt before delegation and independently again after the task result.
The final response compared ROOT_MARKER and CHILD_MARKER as delegation-ok.
Only read and task tools were enabled and the external post-run Git status was clean.

limitations: The probe disabled asynchronous jobs, so agents.wait is proven through blocking task completion rather than background job control.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
